title: Harmonic Digital Convergence
description: A digital signature verification process defines a 'harmonic' integer through a repetitive transformation: replace the number by the sum of the squares of its digits. Repeat the process until the number equals 1 (where it stays), or it loops endlessly in a cycle which does not include 1. An integer is considered harmonic if this process ultimately terminates at 1. Determine whether a given number is harmonic.
output_format: A boolean value (true if n is harmonic, false otherwise).

examples.explanation: Transforms through a sequence that loops infinitely without ever reaching 1.
